instruction: Change the title text color on slide 6 ('Numbers') to green in the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed slide number color to red by navigating to Master View, selecting the slide number placeholder, opening Format > Character > Font Effects, and setting the font color to RGB(255,0,0) via the custom color picker.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, access Master View, select slide number placeholders, change font colors using Format > Character dialog with custom RGB color picker
metadata.task_rationale: Tests font color change on a different target (slide title text instead of slide number) and different color (green), requiring the model to select specific text on a specific slide and change its color
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title text color on slide 6 ('Numbers') to green. Custom getter extracts the font color of the title placeholder on slide index 5. Custom metric compares the actual RGB color to expected green (0,128,0) with a tolerance threshold of 30.

scoring_breakdown.title_color: 1.0 - Title font color matches expected green within tolerance

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide index 5 (0-indexed), corresponding to slide 6 as specified in the instruction
Getter properly identifies the title placeholder (placeholder_format.idx == 0) and extracts RGB color from run-level font color
Metric correctly receives the rules dict directly (expected_color, threshold) and computes Euclidean color distance - proper parameter handling for type='rule'
Expected color [0, 128, 0] is standard green, and threshold 30 provides reasonable tolerance for color variation
Postconfig correctly saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure getter reads the updated state
Minor: Getter only checks the first run with explicit font color; if the title has multiple runs with different colors, only the first is verified. Acceptable for this single-requirement task.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking all runs in the title to ensure the entire title text color was changed, not just the first run
